Please provide the names of the hotels, car rental companies, and restaurants, as well as the total maximum expense for the 5-day trip (assuming 2 meals per day and that we take the most expensive rooms at the hotels, but we both stay in the same room). Thank you!

First, I will get the current year to determine the currency for the prices. Then, I will get the current year and the names of the cities we are planning to visit. After that, I will get the names of the top-rated car rental companies and restaurants for each city. Finally, I will get the names of the best-rated hotels in London and Paris.

<function=get_all_restaurants_in_city>{"city": "London"}{/function>

```
